question: The famous Hindu Temple ‘Koneswaram’ is located in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The **Koneswaram Temple** is a famous Hindu temple located in **Trincomalee, Sri Lanka**.
 
• It is dedicated to **Lord Shiva** and is one of the **Pancha Ishwarams** (five abodes of Shiva) in Sri Lanka.
 
• The temple is situated on **Swami Rock**, a promontory overlooking the Indian Ocean, offering breathtaking views.
 
• Koneswaram is revered as one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites for Hindus worldwide.
 
• The temple has a history dating back over 2,500 years, with references in ancient texts like the **Mahabharata** and **Ramayana**.
 
• It was a major religious and cultural center during the reign of ancient Tamil kings.
 
• The temple was destroyed by Portuguese colonizers in the 17th century and later rebuilt in the 20th century.
 
• It stands as a symbol of resilience and devotion for the Tamil Hindu community.
 
• The temple showcases **Dravidian architecture**, characterized by intricate carvings and towering gopurams (gateway towers).
 
• The main sanctum houses a **Shiva Lingam**, the symbolic representation of Lord Shiva.
 
• The temple complex includes shrines dedicated to other deities like **Lord Ganesha**, **Lord Murugan**, and **Goddess Parvati**.
 
• The location on Swami Rock adds to its spiritual and aesthetic appeal.
 
• Koneswaram Temple is a significant pilgrimage site, especially during festivals like **Maha Shivaratri** and **Thirukoneswaram Ther Thiruvilah**.
 
• Devotees believe that a visit to the temple brings blessings and spiritual fulfillment.
 
• The temple is also associated with the legend of **Ravana**, the demon king of Lanka, who is said to have worshipped Lord Shiva here.
 
• The temple attracts thousands of pilgrims and tourists annually, contributing to Sri Lanka's cultural and religious tourism.
 
• It is a symbol of the shared cultural heritage between India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The annual **Koneswaram Temple Festival** is a major event, featuring processions, rituals, and cultural performances.
 
• The temple's location in Trincomalee, a city with a rich history, adds to its significance.
